The runs are independent serving runs; tails are compared using run-level
medians, not a single best invocation.  The three-run medians are:

| policy | MoE p50 ms | MoE p99 ms | dispatch >20 ms | throughput tokens/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| STOCK | 1.001 | 3.653 | 0.0439% | 1.554 |
| ALWAYS_SYNC | 0.996 | 3.509 | 0.0868% | 1.408 |
| ORACLE selective stream drain | 1.687 | 3.769 | 0.0409% | 1.310 |
| ONLINE_SIMPLE (previous dispatch >=1 ms) | 0.989 | 3.311 | 0.0664% | 1.460 |
| unconditional comm-stream drain | 1.046 | 5.719 | 0.0998% | 1.337 |

The oracle's approximately 7% reduction in the >20 ms rate is not robust,
and it carries a p50/throughput cost.  The simple policy sometimes improves
p99 but increases extreme-tail rate and loses approximately 6% throughput.
